visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a black T-shirt featuring a stylized pink and blue robot graphic is filming himself in a brightly lit indoor home. A young woman in a green sports jersey walks into the background. (2) The scene shifts outdoors to a blue Tesla car. A close-up shows a hand touching a flush door handle which then extends outward. The woman from before opens the door and climbs into the white leather interior. (3) Inside the moving car, the man is seen in the driver's seat and the woman in the passenger seat. She gives a thumbs-up gesture. Suddenly, the camera shakes violently and the image becomes a blurry grey wash to simulate extreme acceleration. (4) Drone footage captures the blue car navigating a winding mountain road surrounded by thick green trees and mountain ridges under a cloudy sky. (5) Detailed close-ups show a 'Plaid' emblem on the rear, a large central touchscreen displaying a red Tesla logo, and the front license plate 'EBG-1973' where blue fluid is spraying out from the undercarriage. (6) The man is now sitting in the open trunk of the blue car at a mountain overlook, holding a green bottle. (7) In an underground parking garage, the man and another male in a pink shirt stand next to the blue Tesla near a charging station, engaged in conversation.
